buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) Additional Terms and Conditions of Bid : 1. Its compulsory for Bidder to submit EMD in hard copy and other documents of staff in hard form before closing date of bid. As per prior experience no exemptions to any one is allow. 2. Attendance register has to be maintained in running classes and hostel, STA for ensuring attendance of l abour appeared inshift it will besigned by contractor‟s representative and it will be verified by the inchar ge. 3. Contractor or his representative will inform well in advance about material before storing in running roo m so that incharge may verify the quantity and quality of being supplied materials for housekeeping, Gard ening and maintenance .Record in this regard should also be maintained. 4. Contractor shall be responsible for the behavior of their Staff. If any case of misbehavior or accident tak e place or done by the contractor staff, competent authority have right to impose the penalty in any such i ncident and have such employee removed and replaced. Contract shall be terminated by the competent a uthority if necessary. 5. The contractor shall ensure fullsafety of their workman deputed for the work.EMRS shall not be held res ponsible for any accident and no compensation shall be claimed either by contractor or their workman. 6. In case any deputed staff by contractor is serious / injured while working on duty, contractor shall be tot ally responsible to provide medical assistance to such employee immediately and if any staff will expire o n duty, then EMRS Authority will not be responsible in any case.

7. The full scope of work and all special conditions will be implemented by the contractor.If any dispute is r aised in this contract, the competent authority will have power to dispose all such disputes. 8. The contractor shall be liable to honor central and state government laws, statutory rules, regulations, modifications like legislation, local self-government, municipal requirement etc. and shall be solely respon sible for any breach thereof. EMRS stands indemnified against any penalty/prosecutions consequent to the violations [deliberate or in advertent] by the contractor or his employees, representative etc. of such statu tory provisions in force. 9. The contractor shall also provide weekly rest on staggered basis to all workers and comply with all othe r provisions of the wages to labour law. 10. The contractor shall not employ person below the age of 18 years as labour directly or indirectly for the execution of work. 11. The contractor shall ensure that all the staff engaged are medically fit and not suffering from any cont agious disease. He shall ensure due Medical Checkup of all his staff once in every year from an authorized medical practitioner (MBBS) and medical fitness certificate to this effect shall be submitted to CCCOR STA for records. If required buyer will asked for the same during joining or before allotting wok contract. 12. Bidder have to fullfill all terms and conditions. and accpetance of terms and conditions (refer ATC) alon g with EMD receiving copy have to submit with bid for technical evaluation. Else bidders are disqualify fro m bid without any intimation. 13. Last decision is taken from BID committee only.
